Department of Food and Nutrition, School of Home Science, BBAU, Lucknow-226025
22 November 2026 (last date of submission of application)

content_sections.heading: About BBAU
content_sections.text: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University is a Central University at Vidya Vihar, Rae Bareli Road, Lucknow-226025. These posts sit in its Department of Food and Nutrition, School of Home Science, under the research project "Strengthening of Technical Support Unit for Rice Fortification Programme of the Government of Uttar Pradesh", implemented within the framework of the WFP India Country Strategic Plan 2023–2027. The Principal Investigator is Prof. Neetu Singh.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application goes by email only, to [email protected] , by 22 November 2026. The notice does not prescribe an email subject line. Fill in the application form in the prescribed format attached to the notice as Annexure-A. Scan the duly filled-in application form. Attach self-attested soft copies of the required documents/certificates. Email the scanned form and the documents to [email protected] by 22 November 2026. Eligible candidates then appear for the interview in offline mode with the documents listed under Enclosures. The Annexure-A form asks for the post applied for, full name, father's name, sex, date of birth, category, marital status, address, mobile number, email ID, nationality, educational qualifications (examination/degree, college/institute, university, years of joining and leaving, percentage of marks, class/division), experience (employer, position held, dates of joining and leaving, pay scale of pay), training details, additional information and a signed declaration with date and place. It also has a box for a photograph.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The appointments are on a fixed-term basis with a fixed consolidated monthly salary. The notice mentions no allowances. Candidates should have a UG degree in Management, Food and Nutrition & Food Processing Management. PG degree in Statistics, Management, or relevant areas provides the core Mathematical, Analytical, and Business Framework. The notice does not mention an age limit or any required experience for either post, though the application form has an experience section and states that experience without certificates shall not be considered. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: With the email application: Scanned copy of the duly filled-in application form (Annexure-A) Self-attested soft copies of the required documents/certificates Photocopies of marksheets and degree/certificates (asked for in the form's educational qualification section) Experience certificates, where experience is claimed To bring to the interview: Filled application form Original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates Two passport-size photographs

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates appear for an interview in offline mode. The notice is titled "Walk-in-Interview", but the interview date, time and venue are not specified in the notice. The decision of the selection committee shall be final.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The positions are purely temporary and will be governed as per the guidelines of the project. The terms and conditions of the appointment shall be governed by the rules and regulations of BBAU, Lucknow and WFP. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview. Experience without certificates shall not be considered. If any information in the application is found false, incomplete or incorrect, the candidature/appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BBAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 posts: 10 Data Collector and 02 Data Analyst in the Department of Food and Nutrition.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of submission of application is 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Data Collector post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a UG degree in Management, Food and Nutrition & Food Processing Management.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Data Analyst post?
faq.answer: A PG degree in Statistics, Management, or relevant areas providing the core Mathematical, Analytical, and Business Framework.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The Data Collector gets 10,000/- and the Data Analyst gets 25,000/-, as a fixed consolidated monthly salary.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-A form and email its scanned copy with self-attested soft copies of your documents/certificates to [email protected] by 22 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates appear for an interview in offline mode, and the decision of the selection committee shall be final.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The duration for both posts is 1 month, on a fixed-term basis; the positions are purely temporary and governed by the project guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. What should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: The filled application form, original documents with one set of self-attested photocopies of certificates, and two passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview.
